about: Kosha search test set, 2026-11-21. 40 queries a builder would ask of this library, 4 added when the LinkedIn saves arrived, and the 12 text queries of the first evaluation. Holds queries and judged item ids only, no item text.
judgments: LLM-made, not checked by a person. Model gpt-5.4 (no reasoning), reading the author, date, content types and the first 2,000 characters of each item's text (body, quoted post, link titles, media extracts) against the `need` sentence. Grades: 2 = directly satisfies the need, 1 = partially relevant, 0 = not relevant.
pooling: Per query, the union of the top 30 of keyword, semantic and hybrid search before the changes; the top 30 of keyword (AND and partial), unfloored semantic (top 40) and four fusions after them; and the top 50 of the adopted hybrid on the X items and on the whole library. An item outside the pool counts as not relevant.
corpus: 7,159 X bookmarks when the pool was first drawn; 833 LinkedIn saves arrived during the work and are covered by the last pooling round.
